assessments.reasoning: The Check project's commit-pinned AWK helper matched the claim's file digest. Lines 11–19 occupy UTF-8 byte range [267, 702), including the terminating newline. The span SHA-256 is 30498c160b13f0299079b7158e8caf59f3ee457c17ef1a51ff8c7d9a67904f66. [Pinned checkmk.in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libcheck/check/11970a7e112dfe243a2e68773f014687df2900e8/checkmk/checkmk.in)

The pinned SPDX details record identifies checkmk and its decoded licenseText matches the publisher span. The cross-reference match flag is false for a moving master URL. Applicability here rests on direct comparison with the pinned publisher capture. [SPDX details](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/checkmk.json)

The complete standalone text from the release commit matches the bounded publisher span byte for byte and yields the same 66 ordered tokens. [SPDX standalone text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/checkmk.txt)

The SPDX repository's tag endpoint returned annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b. Its object field identifies the commit used in both SPDX URLs. The tag is unsigned, so the authority check relies on the repository endpoint and its agreement with the pinned source routes. [SPDX annotated tag object](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Reacquired all four sources in separate connector calls and retained the complete results. Recomputed SHA-256 over the captured UTF-8 bytes. Selected checkmk.in lines 11–19 using the copyright and closing-comment boundaries, lowercased the text, and compared ordered runs of ASCII letters and digits. Decoded licenseText from JSON and compared it and the complete standalone text against the same span. Tested neighboring boundaries and alternate JSON fields. Read the annotated tag object's name, target type and target SHA directly and compared the target against both representation URLs.
challenge.results: All three representations yielded the same 66 ordered tokens and identical 435-byte text. Including the preceding author line yielded 73 tokens. Dropping the copyright line yielded 60, dropping the closing line yielded 57, and extending through the first AWK code line yielded 67. The JSON template and HTML fields yielded 73 and 92 tokens respectively. The annotated v3.29.0 tag targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, which appears in both SPDX representation URLs.

limitations: The finding covers only the specified AWK helper notice and the two pinned SPDX representations. Other files, package-wide licensing, legal equivalence, redistribution and installation are outside scope.
The two SPDX representations share the same SPDX data revision and source lineage.

The bundle digest was compared across the records that declare it. The review covered the supplied policy documents and documentary claim. Release qualification and validation of a separate research execution require their own records.
